title: impact-class.v1
description: A file `classes/<name>.yaml`: an impact class a product adds beside the built-in ones. Its count comes from an executable `classes/<name>.count` that reads the run directory (path in `HAKIT_RUN_DIR`) and prints one JSON array of impacts `{at_ms, stream?, call_id?, detail?}`; the runner attributes each to a window by `at_ms`. ADR-0049.

name.description: Equal to the file stem; unique on the search path and distinct from every built-in class.

unit.description: What one impact counts: a call, or an event that belongs to no call.
